answer: A random beacon, split like a prism, picks 5% of agents each epoch for a compute heartbeat: each must solve a puzzle within 60 seconds, proving a real machine behind every identity in its orchard. A farm claiming 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines or forfeits a 50-POA bond each. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus hardware, while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps earning. In this ocean of agents, cheating costs more than it gains.
